# Rikugan (六眼)

> A reverse-engineering agent that runs natively inside IDA Pro and Binary Ninja.

Rikugan is a native C++ plugin. Its agent — turn loop, model providers and logins, sessions, compaction, retries, skills and MCP — is libomc (oh-my-c), linked in-process; Rikugan adds the host analysis tools, the chat panel, per-database chats, undo, modes, subagents, the bulk renamer, analysis profiles, and RE prompts and skills. It is not an MCP client: the agent talks to the database through Rikugan's own tools. Rikugan 1.x was a Python plugin; it remains only in the git history.

## Pages

- [Home](index.html): overview, features, skills, providers.
- [Documentation](docs.html): installation, models and accounts, settings, usage, commands, modes, skills, MCP, memory, profiles, tool reference.
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.html): libomc embedding, threads, chat lifecycle, system prompt, tool pipeline, undo, modes, subagents, bulk renamer, settings and files, security model.

## Key Facts

- **Hosts**: IDA Pro 9.3 (Hex-Rays for the decompiler tools) and Binary Ninja (UI mode). Linux and macOS.
- **Models**: every provider and login libomc supports (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, Copilot, API keys …), any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, local servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp).
- **Tools**: 50 shared analysis tools, plus 12 Binary Ninja IL tools or 8 IDA microcode/pseudocode tools; 5 chat tools (ask_user, save_memory, spawn_subagent, exploration_report, research_note); read/write/edit/grep/glob/bash/web_search/todo, each disk or shell kind asking once per chat.
- **Binary Ninja MCP**: with `ui.mcp.enabled`, the panel offers Binary Ninja's own MCP tools (`bn_*`) per database. The header's MCP button switches a database between them and Rikugan's analysis tools. Their changes are not in `/undo`.
- **Skills**: 12 built-in; custom skills in `~/.rikugan/omc/agent/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md`.
- **Modes**: `/plan`, `/explore`, `/modify` (explore → plan → execute → save), `/research` (notes next to the database).
- **Undo**: `/undo [N]` reverses renames, comments and prototypes.
- **Script approval**: `execute_python` always asks; it runs in the host's own Python behind a guard.
- **Memory**: `RIKUGAN.md` next to the database, first 200 lines in the system prompt.
- **Files**: settings in `~/.rikugan/config.json`; logins, MCP servers and skills in `~/.rikugan/omc/agent/`; chats in `~/.rikugan/sessions/`.

## Installation

```bash
git clone --recursive https://github.com/buzzer-re/Rikugan
git clone https://github.com/buzzer-re/Oh-My-C ohmyc
cd Rikugan && ./install.sh
```

Needs CMake, a C++20 compiler, OpenSSL 3 and zlib headers, curl, and bsdtar (macOS tar) or 7-Zip. The installer fetches the Qt headers matching each host and installs into the host's plugin directory. Re-run it after a Binary Ninja update.
